text: In this video, I want to talk about some first date mistakes. So here's the deal. You went on a date. You were polite. Took care of the bill. Asked questions. You thought it went fine. But then she pulls away. Says, I'm not feeling it or let's just be friends. You're confused. What did I do wrong? Here's the truth. Most probably, you were either boring or you behaved like a friend rather than a potential lover. You played it safe. Acted like a polite co-worker. Asked about her job, her pets, her travel plans. And don't get me wrong. There's nothing wrong with those topics. After all, you do want her to feel safe and comfortable. But if all you bring is nice guy energy, she might smile. She might enjoy the chat, but she won't remember you. Because attraction isn't just comfort. It's excitement. It's tension. It's energy. You need to flirt. You need to spark curiosity. You need to be the guy whose presence lingers in her mind after the date. When she walks away, she should feel like, damn, I want more of that. So here's the fix. Keep the comfort, but add the spark. Be playful. Be bold. Be present. And show your interest like a man. This will make her feel like a woman. Because no girl is coming back for a second date out of polite boredom.
